function: system, p. 3: client selection and power scaling for analog over-the-air FL gradient aggregation (area 7), but the server and each client have a single antenna and there is no RIS.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Earlier codes do not apply: it is over-the-air FL with analog aggregation (p. 1: "we consider an over-the-air FL system with analog gradient aggregation"), so it passes no_learning, and its problem P1 (p. 4) optimizes the client set and the power scaling factor sigma_t of the analog aggregation under an aggregation MSE constraint, which is the over-the-air aggregation design of area 7 rather than digital FL. It fails the system check, which covers area 7: p. 3: "The server and each client have a single antenna." The received signal (4) on p. 3 uses scalar channels h_k,t ~ CN(0, beta_k) and no RIS; RIS appears only as related work in the introduction (p. 1) and in the references. For the reviewer: if client selection were read as above-PHY scheduling, the code would be above_phy instead; system was chosen because the decision variables include the power scaling (channel-inversion transmit power, eq. (6), p. 4) of the analog aggregation. Quantitative results exist (CIFAR-10 and EMNIST-Letter accuracy, convergence rounds, and energy, pp. 7-8), so results does not apply.
